newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - P Morris unaware of Lion rumour.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - P Morris unaware of Lion rumour.

text.p: U.S. tobacco, food and drinks giant Philip Morris Cos Inc said on Wednesday it was unaware of rumours circulating in the New Zealand share market that it was seen a buyer for all or part of brewing group Lion Nathan Ltd.
"I think that is all it is -- a rumour," said a spokeswoman for Philip Morris Australia, which also oversees the New Zealand operations.
"That is the first I have heard about it. I don't know where they would be coming from," she told Reuters.
Lion Nathan said from New Zealand that speculation that its managing director Douglas Myers was selling his shareholding in the brewer to Philip Morris was unfounded.
New Zealand stockbrokers said the takeover rumour was behind the strong rise in the Wellington-based brewer's share price.
At 12.05 (0105 GMT), Lion Nathan shares traded on the Australian Stock Exchange were 14 cents or 4.53 percent up at A$3.23 on light volume.
